nodes.label: GET /master/users/types (Get User Types)
nodes.rationale: Supplies the value/label pairs behind the numeric user type enum used on user create and update. The documented response schema describes full user objects instead of type objects, which looks like a copy-paste artefact from the users listing endpoint.

edges.source_location: supplies the value/label pairs behind the required type enum (1 INTERNAL, 2 EXTERNAL) on user create
same Master Data/Users tag; type is a query filter on the listing
